words.exampleMeaning: The saying reminds us: whoever strives finds success.

words.meaning: patience is the key to relief
words.exampleMeaning: Grandmother said: patience is the key to relief.

words.example: كَتَبَ الْمُعَلِّمُ عَلَى السَّبُّورَةِ: الْعِلْمُ نُورٌ.
words.exampleMeaning: The teacher wrote on the board: knowledge is light.
My father always says: time is like a sword.

words.example: فِي الْعَمَلِ الْجَمَاعِيِّ، يَدٌ وَاحِدَةٌ لَا تُصَفِّقُ.
words.exampleMeaning: In teamwork, one hand cannot clap.

words.meaning: the best speech is brief and meaningful
words.example: نَصَحَنَا الْمُدِيرُ: خَيْرُ الْكَلَامِ مَا قَلَّ وَدَلَّ.
words.exampleMeaning: The manager advised us: the best speech is brief and meaningful.

words.example: تَقَبَّلَ خَطَأَهُ وَقَالَ: لِكُلِّ جَوَادٍ كَبْوَةٌ.
words.exampleMeaning: He accepted his mistake and said: every noble horse stumbles.

words.meaning: a harmful thing may bring benefit
words.example: بَعْدَ التَّأْخِيرِ ظَهَرَ أَنَّ رُبَّ ضَارَّةٍ نَافِعَةٌ.
words.exampleMeaning: After the delay it became clear that harm may bring benefit.

words.meaning: not everything that glitters is gold
words.example: حَذَّرَنِي صَدِيقِي: مَا كُلُّ مَا يَلْمَعُ ذَهَبًا.
words.exampleMeaning: My friend warned me: not everything that glitters is gold.

words.word: مَنْ حَفَرَ حُفْرَةً لِأَخِيهِ وَقَعَ فِيهَا
words.reading: man ḥafara ḥufratan li-ʾakhīhi waqaʿa fīhā
words.meaning: whoever digs a pit for his brother falls into it
words.example: تُحَذِّرُ الْحِكْمَةُ: مَنْ حَفَرَ حُفْرَةً لِأَخِيهِ وَقَعَ فِيهَا.
words.exampleMeaning: The proverb warns: whoever digs a pit for his brother falls into it.

words.word: لَا تُؤَجِّلْ عَمَلَ الْيَوْمِ إِلَى الْغَدِ
words.reading: lā tuʾajjil ʿamala l-yawmi ʾilā l-ghadi
words.meaning: do not put today’s work off until tomorrow
words.example: عَلَّقْتُ فَوْقَ مَكْتَبِي: لَا تُؤَجِّلْ عَمَلَ الْيَوْمِ إِلَى الْغَدِ.
words.exampleMeaning: I hung above my desk: do not put today’s work off until tomorrow.

words.meaning: in hardships, true friends are known
words.example: ثَبَتَ لَنَا أَنَّ عِنْدَ الشَّدَائِدِ يُعْرَفُ الْإِخْوَانُ.
words.exampleMeaning: It was proven to us that true friends are known in hardship.

words.meaning: each vessel spills what is inside it
words.example: تَظْهَرُ الْأَخْلَاقُ فِي الْكَلَامِ؛ كُلُّ إِنَاءٍ بِمَا فِيهِ يَنْضَحُ.
words.exampleMeaning: Character appears in speech; each vessel spills what is inside it.

words.example: تُعَلِّمُنَا التَّجْرِبَةُ أَنَّ الْقَنَاعَةُ كَنْزٌ لَا يَفْنَى.
words.exampleMeaning: Experience teaches us that contentment is an inexhaustible treasure.
Slow down, for haste is from the devil.

words.meaning: ask the experienced person, not the doctor
words.example: فِي شُؤُونِ السَّفَرِ، سَلِ الْمُجَرِّبَ وَلَا تَسْأَلِ الطَّبِيبَ.
words.exampleMeaning: In travel matters, ask the experienced person, not the doctor.

items.hint: patience is the key to relief

options: patience is the key to relief

items.question: What does ‘الصَّبْرُ مِفْتَاحُ الْفَرَجِ’ mean?
options: patience is the key to relief

items.question: What does ‘الْعِلْمُ نُورٌ’ mean?
options: the best speech is brief and meaningful
